# Camp Pets: Dog Dirt Mound

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Oct 26, 2024
- 1 min read

Updated: Nov 23, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_809deb6729f34a789046241fb5e5cd95~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Your dog will love a place to dig up the ground.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Dog Dirt Mound__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_087384405a534ffcb2cbe14db7d3dba9~mv2.jpg)

Dog

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f53284205d1e4863a965c7509b58517c~mv2.jpg)

No Limit per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

None

Misc

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

1 Flamingo Unit
